disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

engines.dsh: 官方 rc 组合（peer 依赖 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools ^0.0.1、@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow ^0.0.1、cordis ^4.0.0-rc.7）

checked_items.zh: 在全部源码、文档与配置中查找了 API 密钥、口令、私钥、云凭证、钱包助记词等密钥痕迹，未检出任何硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Searched all source code, documentation, and configuration for traces of secrets such as API keys, passwords, private keys, cloud credentials, and wallet mnemonics; no hardcoded credentials were detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了是否读取宿主凭据文件或用户敏感目录（SSH 私钥、云厂商配置、凭据库等），插件没有任何文件读取逻辑，未检出敏感路径访问。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin reads host credential files or user-sensitive directories (SSH private keys, cloud vendor configuration, credential stores, etc.). The plugin has no file-reading logic, so no sensitive path access was detected.

checked_items.zh: 插件自身不含任何网络发送代码，不存在「读取敏感信息后外发」的成链可能，具体见数据外泄维度。
checked_items.en: The plugin itself contains no network-sending code, so no chain of "reading sensitive information and then exfiltrating it" is possible. See the data exfiltration dimension for details.

evidence.zh: 凭据外泄场景核查未命中：全树未出现凭据文件、SSH、云配置等敏感路径引用，插件代码无文件读取能力；子代理的联网行为被限定在宿主官方内置搜索/抓取工具内，插件自身无外发通道。
evidence.en: Credential exfiltration scenario check: not hit. The entire tree contains no sensitive path references (credential files, SSH, cloud configuration, etc.), and the plugin code has no file-reading capability. The sub-agent's network behavior is limited to the host's official built-in search/fetch tools; the plugin itself has no outbound channel.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注册给模型使用的唯一工具（deep_research）的描述文本（src/index.ts 工具注册处），内容为研究编排功能说明与触发条件，未含指令覆写、系统消息伪装、优先级操纵、诱导安装或索取凭据等措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of the only tool registered for model use (deep_research) (at the tool registration in src/index.ts). The content is a research orchestration functional description and trigger conditions, containing no wording for instruction override, system message spoofing, priority manipulation, installation inducement, or credential solicitation.

checked_items.zh: 审查了工作流脚本中发给规划/研究/综合/审查各子代理的全部提示词，均为研究流程指令，明确限制子代理只使用官方内置搜索与抓取工具并要求不得编造来源，未检出注入意图。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all prompts sent to planning/research/synthesis/review sub-agents in the workflow script. They are all research process instructions, explicitly limiting sub-agents to use only the official built-in search and fetch tools and requiring no fabricated sources. No injection intent was detected.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现模型指令文件（技能说明、代理指令、编辑器钩子等）；README 提到的仓库技能模板不在本插件树内，无指令面文件可被加载。
checked_items.en: No model instruction files were found in the entire tree (skill descriptions, agent instructions, editor hooks, etc.). The repository skill template mentioned in the README is not inside this plugin tree, so there is no instruction-surface file that can be loaded.

evidence.zh: 工具描述投毒核查未命中：deep_research 工具描述（src/index.ts 第 403-413 行）为功能说明，不含系统指令或隐藏意图，且未使用系统提示片段注入接口。
evidence.en: Tool description poisoning check: not hit. The deep_research tool description (lines 403-413 in src/index.ts) is a functional description, contains no system instructions or hidden intent, and does not use system-prompt fragment injection interfaces.

evidence.zh: 诱导安装核查未命中：工具描述与 README 均无「安装插件」「改写配置」「放开权限」类措辞；README 中的安装命令属面向用户的安装文档，不进入模型上下文。
evidence.en: Installation inducement check: not hit. Neither the tool description nor the README contains wording like "install plugin", "modify configuration", or "grant permissions". The install command in the README is user-facing installation documentation and does not enter the model context.

checked_items.zh: 静态预扫在构建元数据文件中命中的 3 条机械命中已逐条排除：DG-R3-55 命中（lib/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 出现 child_process 字样）实为 TypeScript 构建缓存中类型定义文件的路径列表，非可执行代码；DG-R3-60 两处命中（lib/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 与 lib/types/index.js.map 的超长单行）为机器生成的构建缓存与源码映射 JSON，属预期结构，无可执行内容，均不构成执行面。
checked_items.en: The 3 mechanical hits from the static pre-scan in build metadata files were excluded one by one: the DG-R3-55 hit (lib/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo contains the string child_process) is actually a path list of type definition files in the TypeScript build cache, not executable code; the two DG-R3-60 hits (the overlong single lines in lib/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo and lib/types/index.js.map) are machine-generated build cache and source map JSON, expected structures with no executable content. None constitute an execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 全树源代码未检出动态执行函数调用、外部进程启动或脚本解释器使用；研究工作流经宿主官方引擎提交（src/index.ts 第 483 行），脚本为静态文本拼接，无模板插值注入面。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution function calls, external process launches, or script interpreter uses were detected in the entire tree's source code. The research workflow is submitted via the host's official engine (line 483 in src/index.ts), and the script is static text concatenation with no template interpolation injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 仅为按包名插入插件行的普通声明，不含动态脚本标签，未检出补丁即执行面。
checked_items.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml is only an ordinary declaration that inserts plugin lines by package name. It contains no dynamic script tags, so no patch-as-execution surface was detected.

checked_items.zh: 包清单无安装/构建后钩子脚本（package.json 脚本仅测试、类型检查、构建），树内不存在钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置、构建脚本等可执行载体。
checked_items.en: The package manifest has no install/post-build hook scripts (package.json scripts are only test, type-check, and build). The tree contains no hook managers, CI workflows, container configurations, build scripts, or other executable carriers.

evidence.zh: 补丁即执行核查未命中：全树唯一 YAML 文件 cordis.patch.yml（第 6-8 行）仅含 insert 插件行声明，无动态脚本标签。
evidence.en: Patch-as-execution check: not hit. The only YAML file in the tree, cordis.patch.yml (lines 6-8), contains only an insert plugin line declaration and no dynamic script tags.

evidence.zh: 自我修改滥用核查未命中：全树无动态包工具调用；插件仅把静态脚本交给官方 workflow 引擎执行（src/index.ts 第 483 行），属声明的官方机制。
evidence.en: Self-modification abuse check: not hit. The tree contains no dynamic package-tool calls. The plugin only hands a static script to the official workflow engine for execution (line 483 in src/index.ts), which is a declared official mechanism.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子核查未命中：package.json 脚本（第 26-30 行）只有测试/类型检查/构建，无安装期钩子；树内无钩子管理器、CI、容器等执行载体。
evidence.en: Install hook check: not hit. package.json scripts (lines 26-30) only include test/type-check/build with no install-time hooks. The tree contains no hook managers, CI, containers, or other execution carriers.

evidence.zh: 浏览器端自动加载场景不适用：包清单未声明 dsh.client（package.json 第 41-45 行仅声明 bundle 补丁），无浏览器端代码面。
evidence.en: Browser-side auto-loading scenario: not applicable. The package manifest does not declare dsh.client (package.json lines 41-45 declare only a bundle patch), so there is no browser-side code surface.

checked_items.zh: 全树未检出任何网络发送代码（无 HTTP 客户端、WebSocket、命令行下载工具、原始套接字等），插件自身零外联面。
checked_items.en: No network-sending code was detected in the entire tree (no HTTP client, WebSocket, command-line download tool, raw socket, etc.). The plugin itself has zero outbound surface.

checked_items.zh: 未检出编码/压缩/混淆后外发的数据流，也不存在把请求或代理指向非官方端点的配置。
checked_items.en: No data flow for encoded/compressed/obfuscated exfiltration was detected, nor any configuration that points requests or proxies to non-official endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 研究工作流的联网行为全部经由宿主官方内置搜索/抓取工具执行，属声明机制，不在插件自身外联面内。
checked_items.en: All network behavior of the research workflow is executed through the host's official built-in search/fetch tools. This is a declared mechanism and is outside the plugin's own outbound surface.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查未命中：插件无自身网络代码与敏感路径读取，凭据加外联的组合不成立；子代理仅被授权使用官方内置搜索/抓取工具。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: not hit. The plugin has no network code and no sensitive path reading, so the credential-plus-outbound combination does not hold. Sub-agents are only authorized to use the official built-in search/fetch tools.

checked_items.zh: 运行时依赖为空，仅开发期依赖 TypeScript 与类型定义；对等依赖指向官方 dsh 工具包与 cordis，未发现仿冒或抢注包名。
checked_items.en: Runtime dependencies are empty; only development dependencies (TypeScript and type definitions) exist. Peer dependencies point to the official dsh toolkit and cordis. No impersonated or squatted package names were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁只插入插件行，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，无禁用项、无环境变量降权写法、无注入或拦截配置改写。
checked_items.en: The patch only inserts plugin lines and does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration. There are no disabled items, no environment-variable privilege-dropping patterns, and no injection or interception configuration rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 包清单无安装钩子与可变引用依赖；作者身份未在包清单中声明，无法从快照核验，已在审计限制中注明。
checked_items.en: The package manifest has no install hooks and no variable-reference dependencies. The author identity is not declared in the package manifest, so it cannot be verified from the snapshot; this is noted in the audit limitations.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本可比较，升级自动激活类信号不适用。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit, so there is no previous version to compare against; upgrade auto-activation signals are not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁覆盖安全行核查未命中：cordis.patch.yml 全文无沙箱/审批/权限配置覆盖，无禁用项与环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: Patch overriding security lines check: not hit. The entire cordis.patch.yml contains no sandbox/approval/permission configuration overrides, no disabled items, and no environment-variable privilege-dropping patterns.

evidence.zh: 审批链截断核查未命中：插件未注册任何审批/预执行类事件监听，不存在截断审批链的代码路径。
evidence.en: Approval chain truncation check: not hit. The plugin registers no approval/pre-execution event listeners, so there is no code path that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 升级自动激活场景不适用：本次为首次审计，无上一版本清单可比较声明突变。
evidence.en: Upgrade auto-activation scenario: not applicable. This is the first audit, and there is no previous version manifest to compare for declared mutations.

evidence.zh: 注入/拦截篡改核查未命中：补丁未改写相关配置；源码中 inject 字样（src/index.ts 第 70 行）是插件自身向宿主声明所需服务，非配置覆盖。
evidence.en: Injection/interception tampering check: not hit. The patch does not rewrite relevant configuration. The string inject in the source (line 70 in src/index.ts) is the plugin declaring required services to the host, not a configuration override.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动本地服务或监听端口，未检出；插件仅注册模型面工具，运行期全部依赖宿主引擎。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a local service or listens on a port; none was detected. The plugin only registers a model-facing tool and relies entirely on the host engine at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 本次审计未做动态沙箱运行验证（无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为结论基于静态分析，已在审计限制中注明。
checked_items.en: This audit did not perform dynamic sandbox runtime verification (no dynamic sandbox artifacts). Runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis; this is noted in the audit limitations.

evidence.zh: 本机无认证接口场景不适用：插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，不存在本地可达接口面。
evidence.en: Local unauthenticated interface scenario: not applicable. The plugin starts no web service and listens on no port, so there is no locally reachable interface surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：包清单声明 bundle 补丁且与补丁内容一致，名称无仿冒嫌疑，依赖指向官方包。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the package manifest declares a bundle patch consistent with the patch content, the name shows no impersonation suspicion, and dependencies point to official packages.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：全树规则面扫描，3 条机械命中全部位于构建元数据（DG-R3-55、DG-R3-60），经核查无可执行内容并全部排除；源码无危险执行、网络、凭据命中。
summary.en: Static scan passed: full-tree rule-based scan. All 3 mechanical hits are located in build metadata (DG-R3-55, DG-R3-60), verified to contain no executable content and all excluded. Source code has no dangerous execution, network, or credential hits.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与子代理提示词语义审查未检出注入意图，无指令面文件。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: semantic review of the tool description and sub-agent prompts detected no injection intent, and there are no instruction-surface files.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物），运行时结论基于静态分析。能力声明面仅含 bundle 补丁，network/shell/fs 按代码实测推断为无、modelFacing 为有。构建产物（构建缓存、源码映射）经规则扫描与抽样核验，未逐字通读。作者身份未在包清单声明，无法核验，author 字段取仓库属主且未验证；LICENSE 版权署名与仓库属主不一致，不涉及安全结论。全树 15 个文件与文件清单一致，无清单外文件。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts); runtime conclusions are based on static analysis. The declared capability surface contains only the bundle patch; network/shell/fs are inferred as absent based on code inspection, and modelFacing as present. Build artifacts (build cache, source maps) underwent rule scanning and sampling verification but were not read word by word. Author identity is not declared in the package manifest and cannot be verified; the author field is taken from the repository owner and not verified. The LICENSE copyright attribution differs from the repository owner, which does not affect security conclusions. All 15 files in the tree match the file manifest, with no files outside the manifest.
